_readme: Completed Motorbotz inspections, keyed by listing slug.
This is the ONLY thing that can put the MOTORBOTZ VERIFIED badge on a car.
An entry here means an engineer physically inspected that vehicle and signed
the report. Nothing else — not a dealer's claim, not a source's badge, not a
customer's inspection request — may set it.
Valid points: Exterior, Interior, Engine, Transmission, Suspension, Brakes,
Tyres, Electrical, AC, Accident damage, Odometer, Documents.
Empty because no inspection has been carried out on the sample records.
